releases.notes:
New in this minor release:

- Entity traits are compared and kept while stacking entities.
- Whenever a StackEntity is killed a new entity with the same traits is spawned.

Traits that are checked:
- Age
- Bee Pollination level
- Cat Type
- Items held by a drowned
- Fox Type
- Horse Color
- Leash
- Llama Color
- Love Mode (if Animals are ready to breed)
- Mooshroom Variant
- Parrot Variant
- Piglin Baby
- Potion
- Sheep Color
- Sheep Sheared
- Slime Size
- Turtle Has Egg
- Zoglin Baby
- Zombie Baby

Tested traits:
- Age (doesn't work unless an entity has existed for several ticks already)
- Cat Type
- Sheep Color

releases.notes:
Most basic version of StackMob

- Stacks mobs on spawn
- Respawns a stackmob if the stack size is larger then 0
- Does very basic type check to prevent different species from merging

[Required]
- Install [Cardinal Components](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/cardinal-components)
- Install [Fabric API Mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api) (required for Cardinal Components)
